name: 89703 · Carson City, NV
findings: ZIP 89703 (Carson City) has 148 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89703 (Carson City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
53% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 89703 (Carson City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
